decks.notes: The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to swarm the board with low-cost creatures like Thraben Inspector and Ornithopter, and then use cards like Reckless Bushwhacker and Resolute Reinforcements to pump them up for massive damage. The deck also utilizes cards like Venerated Loxodon and Clarion Spirit to further buff your creatures and overwhelm your opponent quickly. With Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion, you have access to an additional mana source to help you maintain pressure on your opponent. This deck aims to go wide and go fast to overpower your opponent.

The deck relies on generating a massive amount of green mana through devotion effects and ramp creatures to play powerful green creatures and planeswalkers quickly. The strategy revolves around overwhelming the opponent with efficient threats and using cards like Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and Wolfwillow Haven to generate large amounts of mana to cast multiple spells per turn. The combination of ramp creatures, devotion enablers, and powerful threats create a fast and aggressive green-based deck that aims to outpace opponents and quickly close out games.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creatures and efficient threats to overwhelm the opponent quickly. With a strong mix of creatures and spells, the deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early and close out the game before they can stabilize. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an extra layer of consistency and versatility to the deck. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure smooth curve-outs and provide the colors needed for the deck's spells and abilities.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Greasefang Parhelion combo to generate a powerful board presence and overwhelm the opponent. It includes cards that support the combo, such as Raffine's Informant and Can't Stay Away, as well as disruption tools like Thoughseize and Witherbloom Command. The deck aims to quickly assemble the combo pieces, protect them with removal spells, and then dominate the board with the Parhelion II and Greasefang creatures. The inclusion of various lands and additional threats like Skysovereign and Liliana of the Veil adds versatility and resilience to the strategy.

This deck focuses on utilizing sacrifice synergies to overwhelm the opponent with constant pressure. By sacrificing small creatures like Cauldron Familiar and using effects like Claim the Firstborn to steal and sacrifice opposing creatures, the deck aims to control the board while dealing damage with cards like Mayhem Devil and Bloodtithe Harvester. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the deck aims to maintain a strong board presence while disrupting the opponent's strategy to secure a victory through aggressive tactics.

The main focus of this deck is to rapidly ramp up green mana through cards like Llanowar Elves, Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, and Elvish Mystic, in order to play powerful green creatures and planeswalkers like Cavalier of Thorns, Karn, the Great Creator, and Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner. The deck also utilizes the devotion mechanic to generate additional mana and buffs for creatures. Storm the Festival and Oath of Nissa help dig for key cards, while Wolfwillow Haven provides additional mana acceleration. Lair of the Hydra and Polukranos Reborn offer additional threats and Boseiju, Who Endures helps protect important spells from countermagic.

The main idea of this UW Control deck is to maintain control of the game by countering opponents' spells, wiping the board with Supreme Verdict, and gaining card advantage with Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Memory Deluge. The deck also utilizes Shark Typhoon for token generation and potential finisher. Portable Hole and Field of Ruin provide removal options, while the inclusion of quick spells like Spell Pierce and Censor ensures the ability to disrupt opponents' game plans. Overall, this deck aims to stall the game until it can establish a dominant board presence and secure victory.

The main concept of this deck is to ramp up quickly with mana creatures such as Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic, while utilizing Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and Oath of Nissa to generate massive amounts of green mana. This mana is then used to play powerful green devotion cards like Old-Growth Troll and Cavalier of Thorns to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy. Additionally, cards like Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Karn, the Great Creator provide additional support and card advantage to further boost the deck's efficiency and consistency.

This deck focuses on playing low-cost white creatures and pumping them up with cards like Thalia's Lieutenant and Brave the Elements to quickly overwhelm the opponent. Cards like Adeline, Resplendent Cathar and Brutal Cathar provide additional power to the board, while cards like Dauntless Bodyguard and Coppercoat Vanguard help protect key creatures. Mutavault and Shefet Dunes provide additional utility and mana fixing. The deck aims to maintain a fast and aggressive pace, overwhelming the opponent with a swarm of weenie creatures.

The focal point of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy using low-cost creatures and anthem effects. By flooding the board with small creatures like Kytheon, Thalia's Lieutenant, and Adeline, the deck aims to quickly build a wide and powerful army. Cards like Brave the Elements and Castle Ardenvale provide protection and additional threats, while Declaration in Stone can help deal with opposing threats. With a focus on synergy and efficiency, the deck looks to apply early pressure and maintain board presence to secure victory.

This deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Worldspine Wurm and Xenagos, God of Revels early in the game. It also includes cards like Impulse','','');">Fiery Impulse and Spikefield Hazard to control the board while looking for the combo pieces. The deck aims to be quick and aggressive, utilizing spells like Mirrex and Volcanic Spite to finish off opponents. Secrets of the Key and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker add to the creativity aspect of the deck, allowing for unexpected plays and powerful synergies.

This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly with devotion to green creatures and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx to cast powerful threats like Cavalier of Thorns, Old-Growth Troll, and Polukranos Reborn. Karn, the Great Creator and Storm the Festival provide additional utility and card advantage, while Lair of the Hydra can create massive threats. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its aggressive creatures and efficient mana production, utilizing a mix of ramp spells, powerful threats, and card advantage engines to secure victory.

The main focus of this Mono Black Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's hand and game plan with cards like Thoughtseize, Sign in Blood, and Graveyard Trespasser. It aims to control the board with removal spells such as Fatal Push and Power Word Kill, while generating card advantage with Castle Locthwain and Liliana of the Veil. The deck also utilizes powerful finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Invoke Despair to close out the game. Overall, the key strategy is to control the game through disruption, removal, card advantage, and powerful threats.

The deck focuses on playing aggressively with Spirit creatures while utilizing tempo plays to control the opponent's board. Mausoleum Wanderer and Spell Queller provide disruption, while Curious Obsession and Shacklegeist help maintain card advantage and pressure the opponent. Supreme Phantom boosts the power of Spirit creatures, while Hengegate Pathway and Mutavault provide additional mana sources and potential combat tricks. The deck also includes some protection with Lofty Denial and Geistlight Snare. Overall, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with its evasive creatures and efficient spells.

This deck focuses on applying pressure quickly and efficiently using aggressive creatures and removal spells to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. It combines powerful threats like Bonecrusher Giant and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse with disruption like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to maintain tempo and force the opponent to react defensively. The deck also has some graveyard synergies with cards like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Graveyard Trespasser to provide additional value and fuel its powerful creatures. By being proactive and disruptive, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a quick victory.

The main focus of this deck is to assemble the Greasefang Parhelion combo as quickly as possible. This is achieved through cards like Thoughtseize, Grisly Salvage, and Vessel of Nascency to find and fuel the combo pieces. The deck also includes disruption spells like Duress to control the opponent's hand. The combo pieces, including Greasefang, Okiba Boss, Parhelion II, and Esika's Chariot, are crucial for creating a strong board presence and overwhelming the opponent. Supporting cards like Witherbloom Command and Liliana of the Veil help to control the board and protect the combo.
